scope: Physical D1-D6 indicator-driver relay-package crosswalk. K1-K20 map the latching relay drive network; K21/K22 map the non-latching function drive paths. AGC Channel 010 logical row/bit addresses remain a separate joined layer.

interconnect2005954A.description: Original 2005954A AGC DSKY interconnecting-diagram scan frames recovered from Internet Archive aperture-card images.
interconnect2005954A.normalization: The drawing's slashed-zero glyph is normalized to ASCII 0 in signal names.

schematic2005973.description: Virtual AGC KiCad/netlist transcription of drawing 2005973, used for generic K1-K22 internal package-to-module-terminal topology.

relayPinMeaning.magneticLatchingPredecessor: NASA/MIT SCD 1006282 shows the two magnetic-latching drive windings on relay terminals 1-5 and 9-10. It is used only to interpret the 2005973 symbol/pad drive topology, not as proof of production 2004688 timing.
relayPinMeaning.nonLatchingPredecessor: NASA/MIT SCD 1010784 contains multiple predecessor dash/pinout variants (schematic A coil 3-7; schematic B coil 1-5), so 1010784 alone is not used to infer the production 2004689-2 drive pin. The production proof instead comes from 2003910-021 plus drawing 2005973, which identifies K21/K22 as 2004689-2 and explicitly states that positive voltage on pin 1 switches the relay circuit.

productionNonLatchingRelay.description: Production relay-circuit assembly 2003910-021 calls out two 2004689-2 relays per D1-D6 module. Drawing 2005973 identifies K21 & K22 as 2004689-2 and states that the K21/K22 relay circuit switches from the shown position when positive voltage is applied on relay pin 1.
productionNonLatchingRelay.driveInstruction: RELAY CKT FOR K21 & K22 TO SWITCH FROM POSITION SHOWN, APPLY PLUS VOLTAGE ON PIN 1
productionNonLatchingRelay.sourceBoundary: This proves the production design-basis drive pin/dash assignment used for the function-to-package join. Exact 2004689-2 operate/release timing remains unrecovered. K22 switched-contact topology is separately resolved for the 2003910-021 / 2003952-031 configuration by 2003910 Rev E assembly jumpers; serial-number-specific provenance remains separate.

alternateSchematic2005940A.description: Virtual AGC transcription of original drawing 2005940A, checked specifically to determine whether the documented K22 disagreement affects the drive-function join.
alternateSchematic2005940A.result: K21 and K22 use the same relay drive pins/networks as 2005973 (pin 1 driven, pin 5 common). The apparent K22 switched-contact difference is reconciled for 2003910-021 by the Rev E assembly jumpers K22-8->4, K22-7->3, and K22-6->2, which make the 2005940A pinout match 2005973.

nonLatchingDriveJoin.description: 2005954A routes the 12 external annunciator-control signals to D1-D6 module terminals 85/86. In 2005973, terminal 85 feeds R22/C6/Q12 and returns on terminal 87; 2005954A loops 87 to module terminal 4, which 2005973 connects to K22 pin 1. Terminal 86 feeds R24/C7/Q13 and returns on terminal 95; 2005954A loops 95 to terminal 7, which 2005973 connects to K21 pin 1. Both K21/K22 pin 5 returns use module terminal 26.

joinMethod: Read D1-D6 external module-terminal signal labels from 2005954A.
Join the same numeric module terminals to K1-K20 relay pads in 2005973.
Preserve steering-diode traversal explicitly instead of treating it as a direct net.
Require all four drive pads (1,5,9,10) for all 20 latching relays in every D module to resolve.
Join the 12 external non-latching control signals on D1-D6 terminals 85/86 through the 2005973 Q12/Q13 drive paths and the 2005954A 87->4 / 95->7 internal jumpers to K22/K21 pin 1.
Cross-check 2005940A and reconcile its apparent K22 contact difference with the 2003910 Rev E -021 assembly jumpers; preserve serial-number-specific provenance as a separate boundary.

K21.mappingRule: module input terminal 86 -> Q13 -> terminal 95 -> terminal 7 -> K21 pin 1; K21 pin 5 -> terminal 26
K21.note: Function-to-package drive mapping is source-joined for all D1-D6 K21 packages. This does not establish exact 2004689-2 mechanical timing.

K22.mappingRule: module input terminal 85 -> Q12 -> terminal 87 -> terminal 4 -> K22 pin 1; K22 pin 5 -> terminal 26
K22.note: Function-to-package drive mapping is source-joined for all D1-D6 K22 packages. 2003910 Rev E resolves the apparent switched-contact difference for the -021 assembly by requiring jumpers K22-8->4, K22-7->3, and K22-6->2; applied to 2005940A, those jumpers produce the 2005973 K22 connectivity exactly.

limitations: This file is the physical-package-to-DSKY-internal-signal layer. The downstream AGC Channel 010 row/bit -> physical D1-D6/K1-K20 join is now proven separately in docs/relay-logical-physical-crosswalk-2005918.json.
It is configuration-level design/assembly evidence. Serial-number-specific provenance is still required before claiming an arbitrary flown unit used this configuration.
K21/K22 function-to-package drive mapping is proven at the production design-document level, but exact 2004689-2 mechanical timing remains unrecovered.

The 2005973-vs-2005940A K22 switched-contact discrepancy is resolved for the 2003910-021 / 2003952-031 configuration by 2003910 Rev E assembly jumpers. Serial-number-specific provenance is still required before extending that configuration claim to an arbitrary flown unit.

downstreamLogicalCrosswalk.evidence: Original 2005918 relay-word/XDI/YDI signal flow joined to this D1-D6/K1-K20 package-signal crosswalk.
